exam: 106年公務人員高等考試三級考試暨普通考試
subject: 海事英文

essays.text:
試以英文或中文解釋下列海事專有詞彙：（每小題 5 分，共 20 分）
① Drop back (to)
② Give way
③ Slings
④ Veering (of winds)

SMCP 海事英文中譯英：（每小題 5 分，共 30 分）
①於上浪時關閉貨艙通風
②所有損管設備完善且可使用
③檢查放艇設施之繫固並回報
④根據部署表攜帶你的應急設備
⑤我們需要擔架運送受傷人員
⑥殘油泥已泵入殘油泥艙
試將下列 Notice to Mariners 文件譯為中文：（20 分）（請接背面）106年公務人員普通考試試題類科代號：44760全一張（背面）科：航海技術目：海事英文

試將下列有關國際海事組織的部分簡介譯為中文：（30 分）IMO has developed a concept of a Sustainable Maritime Transportation System, whichincludes a set of goals and actions, to highlight the importance of maritime transportationby focusing on： Safety culture and environment stewardship; Education and training in maritime professions, and support for seafarers; Energy efficiency and ship-port interface; Energy supply for ships; Maritime traffic support and advisory systems; Maritime Security; Technical co-operation; New technology and innovation; Finance, liability and insurance mechanisms; and Ocean Governance.
